longDescription:
GCSE computer science revision that adapts to you. Codemere covers the DfE GCSE computer science subject content and the specification points we mapped from AQA 8525, Pearson Edexcel 1CP2, OCR J277 and WJEC Eduqas: algorithms and computational thinking, Python programming, robust programs and SQL, data representation, Boolean logic, computer systems, networks, cyber security and ethical, legal and environmental issues.

### How It Teaches
- Short check-ins after every idea: 5, 10, 20 or all questions, at the difficulty you choose or let the app choose.
- The app remembers, on your device only, what you know and when it is fading. Every miss links straight to the lesson for that topic and says why it suggests the next one.
- Unit tests, a cumulative test and timed board-style mock papers end with a report: weak topics, links to fix them and a short study plan.

### The Trace Bench
Step through real Python line by line. Before each step you predict the next value, line or output, then the variables, trace table, output and flowchart update. Plus labs for binary, hex and shifts, logic gates and truth tables, sorting and searching, the fetch-decode-execute cycle, images, sound and file size, ciphers and network packets.

### Two Ways to Study, One Progress
- Syllabus: the national subject content in its published order.
- Build it: build real programs (a quiz game, a password checker, a secret-message tool, a storage calculator, a library lookup, a smart-home alarm). Each step teaches what it needs, just in time, then checks you. Finished programs go on your Made-it shelf.

### Everything Else
- 68 topics and 2,487 original questions with an explanation for each, mapped to 221 specification points (140 from the DfE subject content, the rest from the four board specifications) with at least 8 questions per point, plus 8 board-style mock papers and a Coverage screen that shows your mastery for every point and where it comes from.
- Other boards: an optional, quiet chip shows where each topic sits in A Level, IB and AP.
- Text size from 50% to 300%. Works offline. No account.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by AQA, Pearson Edexcel, OCR, WJEC/Eduqas, Ofqual or the Department for Education. Practice only; it does not predict grades. Specifications change, so check your own board's.
